name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A profile image with a text fallback, a presence dot, and a stack of peers.
docs: ## When to use - A person or an entity next to content they own: a comment, an assignee, a commit. - A stack of participants, with a `+3` tile for the rest. - A presence indicator on a collaborator, via `AvatarBadge`. ## When not to use - A logo that must stay legible at small sizes; use the image with a fixed box. - A decorative illustration; avatars imply a person or an account. - More than about five faces. Past that the stack stops being readable — use `AvatarGroupCount` with a name list in the tooltip. ## Installation ```bash npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/avatar ``` ## Usage ```tsx import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from "@/components/cadence/avatar/avatar"; export function Author() { return ( AL ); } ``` ## Examples ### Sizes `size` sets `data-size` on the root; every child reads it through `group/avatar`. ```tsx … … … ``` ### Presence ```tsx AL ``` ### Group ```tsx AL GH +3 ``` ## API | Part | Props | Notes | | ------------------ | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | | `Avatar` | `size`, Base UI root props | `size`: `"default" \| "sm" \| "lg"`. Sets `data-size`. | | `AvatarImage` | Base UI image props | `src`, `alt`. Hidden automatically when the image fails. | | `AvatarFallback` | Base UI fallback props | Rendered while loading and after an error. | | `AvatarBadge` | native span props | Corner dot; sized from the root's `data-size`. | | `AvatarGroup` | native div props | Overlapping stack with a ring in the page colour. | | `AvatarGroupCount` | native div props | The `+3` tile that closes a stack. | All parts carry `data-slot`, so `[&>[data-slot=avatar]]:size-6` style overrides are possible without a prop. ## Motion contract No motion (T0). The image-to-fallback swap is instant by design: Base UI knows when the image errored, and a cross-fade would show a half-drawn face in the meantime. | Phase | Properties | Token | Interruptible | | ------- | ---------- | ----- | ------------- | | – | none | – | – | | reduced | none | – | – | | none | none | – | – | ## Accessibility - `AvatarImage` is an ``: always pass a real `alt`. With a name beside the avatar, use `alt=""` so it is not announced twice. - `AvatarFallback` prints initials. Those initials are the accessible name when the image is missing, so derive them from the person's actual name. - `AvatarBadge` is a visual dot. Give it a text alternative when the presence state matters — e.g. `Online` inside it, or an `aria-label` on the badge. - An avatar that links to a profile must be wrapped in an `` with an accessible name; the image `alt` alone is not a link name. ## Notes for AI - Always render an `AvatarFallback`; without it a failed image leaves an empty hole. - Do not animate the presence dot. State lives in the DOM (`aria-label`, text), not in a pulse.
